notes: Elevation generator (right): projects every façade run (straight or curved) onto the drawing plane with a painter's algorithm — piers, glazing per storey, floor lines, cornices; the R-14 m corner shows the correct foreshortening of its bays. Same façade parameters drive the 3D renders, so drawings and visualisations cannot drift apart.

Synthesis agent is cross-checking the full programme (all 193 rooms, Sejmik and Kancelaria groups) against the K5 floor plates before fixing coordinates — slow but this is where the competition is won (jury criterion a).
Critical design decision under evaluation: 12 m Sejmik storey (K5) vs. one more office floor — weighed against MPZP 35 m minimum roof in zone A and the 150 M PLN cap.

Production plan after the spec: (1) parametric model & room layout → table F.15.B; (2) drawings; (3) 3D building + 10 renders incl. F.17 montages; (4) F.14.B cost & F.15 tables; (5) 5 × A3 text; (6) 8 + 2 boards; (7) jury simulation & compliance audit loop.
Graphic style of drawings will be lightened for the boards (pale glazing, hierarchy of line weights) — the test uses dark glass for legibility of the projection only.
